questions: When a price changes, do you want to be able to edit the price of something already on the list, or will you just remove it and add it again?
Do some things come in different sizes or packs (for example, one tin of milk vs. a carton) with different prices? Should each size be listed separately?
When you look up a price, will you type the full exact name, or do you want it to find things from part of the name (for example, typing 'rice' shows all the rice)?
answers: Yes, prices change all the time, especially sugar, rice and oil. I need to change the price of an item.
